retrieval_status: All 77 selected Library records (76 original media files plus one v1.1 complete package) were downloaded using Library-returned GET transfers. Each downloaded record size matches Library metadata and SHA-256 is recorded. Nineteen v1.1 artwork members were extracted and hashed. Across 95 candidate artworks, nine v1.1 files are byte-identical to v1.0 and map to canonical copies, leaving 86 unique stored images: 46 in rustui-images and 40 in ui-images. All stored images passed hash verification. Manual visual comparison covered seven version-sensitive candidates only: three #02 versions, two #16 versions and two P28 versions; the full collection was not visually inspected. The omitted initial user-reference image payload is not part of this generated asset set.

manual_visual_review.scope: Three #02 candidates, two #16 candidates, and two P28 candidates; no claim that all other stored images were visually inspected.
